candidate.title: Feed-polled TopicEmbed imports can lose category and land in Uncategorized when no EmbeddableHost matches
reports: app/models/topicembed.rb:36 behavior change: category previously came from sitesetting.embedcategory but now eh.try(:categoryid) is nil when no host record matches (e.g. topicembed.import from feed polling with non-matching url), silently posting to no category

app/models/topicembed.rb:36 — feed-polled imports (jobs::pollfeed -> topicembed.import) are not gated by hostallowed?, so urls whose host has no embeddablehost row now get category: nil instead of the old embedcategory, silently dumping topics into uncategorized.

[medium/data] app/models/topicembed.rb:36-42 — for rss/atom feed polling (which doesn't go through ensureembeddable), recordforhost(feedpollingurl) may return nil, so eh.try(:categoryid) yields nil and imported topics lose their category entirely (previously defaulted to sitesetting.embedcategory)

app/models/topicembed.rb:43 — the global embedcategory fallback is deleted and category now derives solely from recordforhost(url), so imports whose url host has no embeddablehost row (e.g. feed-polling items from feedpollingurl on a different host) silently change from the configured embed category to nil/uncategorized (p2, conf 50)
candidate.example: topicembed.rb sets category to nil when no embeddablehost matches the url, silently creating uncategorized topics instead of falling back to sitesetting.uncategorizedcategoryid
